verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a GPU cloud platform with an official CLI, SDK and agent skill, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking or any opt-out control for the console, CLI, SDK or agent skill. Scoped API keys and SSH security are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
